## Requirements (contract § In scope)

1. **Identities as code.** A committed, dry-run-by-default script
   (declared bindings in one reviewed file) creating `sig-api-rt`
   (`roles/cloudsql.client`; accessor on `sig-pg-password` only),
   `sig-web-rt` (`roles/storage.objectViewer` on the web bucket only)
   and `sig-alerts-rt` (no project roles); `--verify` diffs the live
   IAM against the declaration.
2. **Per-consumer secret accessors.** Each secret's IAM grants
   accessor only to its consumers' SAs (11 secrets; `sig-api-env`
   recorded, not deleted); the compute SA keeps its accessor grants
   until P34.42b.
3. **Services on their SAs.** Deploy scripts pass `--service-account`
   (AR-8); one same-image revision per service — not a code roll.
4. **`sig-alerts` invoked with IAM (G1-11).** Remove `allUsers`
   invoker; grant `roles/run.invoker` to the caller's current identity
   (P34.42b moves it to `sig-probe-rt`).
5. **Proof without destruction.** Read-only IAM analysis shows each
   service SA lacks delete on the spine and evidence stores and lacks
   other secrets; no deletion attempted as a probe.
